turns.text: Hi, I placed an order recently but bought the wrong size. I want to cancel it.
I'm sorry about the mix-up. I can help with that. Please send me the order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
Order SC-4050, email sarah.jenkins.v2@example.com. Please cancel the order.

I've filed the cancellation request for order SC-4050. Under our policy, an order can be cancelled while it is paid and production has not started. Staff must approve the request and the refund, so nothing is cancelled yet. A colleague will take over and follow up with you.

rule.ro: O comandă se poate anula cât timp este plătită și producția nu a început. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: An order can be cancelled while it is paid and production has not started. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Customer wants to cancel SC-4050 (wrong size). Cancellation request R-1 filed, pending staff approval, including refund.
Cancellation R-1 filed for SC-4050 (wrong size); awaiting staff approval and refund decision.
